towers.name: west

towers.stageMethod: CAD fixes octagon plans and44.253/48.769 cap levels; three open-stage extents are photographic interpretations; separate parapet heights from DSM rim samples.

facade.interpretation: Central cornice and buttress tops checked with added DSM frame points. Rose/portal widths, relief depths and openings are fitted photographic estimates; their backing remains solid.

municipal.extraction: Streaming line-delimited top-level objects of the pretty -OJSON output. Decode only each MESH object; do not load the full 396 MB document. Non-mesh header/table records can contain non-JSON LibreDWG values.
municipal.acceptedBasilicaRule: Horizontal municipal roof union intersects the physical basilica OSM footprint by at least 65 percent. This is a geometric screening rule, not an ownership or final model decision.
municipal.coverageInterpretation: The generous extracted box covers the whole basilica, its rear chapel and nearby buildings. Missing 58.37 m2 at the OSM/CAD perimeter is registration/generalisation, not a neighbourhood-boundary truncation. Retain both source outlines for review.
municipal.preservation: The original archive, DWG and full converted JSON are shared with Palau. Do not remove, download again or reconvert them.

sourceProvenance.vertical: ICGC 2021-2023 LiDAR GetFeatureInfo; EGM08D595 orthometric metres ASL
sourceProvenance.rearScope: Include only verified Capella Santissim OSM footprint. Clip all rear CAD pieces to it. Exclude111.666m2 unresolved northern strip.
sourceProvenance.externalPhotos: Qestudi2013 restoration execution and TMB official photographs; original reconstruction, no redistributed photos or third-party mesh.

interpretations.roofs: Main roof shallow planes: axis-only samples constrain ridge only, multi-point +/-3m sections constrain side falls; cells at +/-6.7/7m that may sample parapets are excluded from the bulk fit. Local isolated maxima above37.818m are fixtures. Roof floor35.5m limits extrapolation at edges. Side terraces retain municipal plane31.826m.
interpretations.walls: Large window recesses and arch surrounds only; minute tracery, statues and hemispherical roof fittings omitted.
interpretations.towers: Octagonal massive lower bodies with three upper open arched stages. Separate measured terrace heights; sparse estimated metal crown on east tower.
interpretations.foundations: Y0 at2m ASL, below measured basilica DTM4.092–5.308m. Footprint-confined subgrade connection only; no additional terrain or surrounding plinth.
interpretations.towerEnvelope: The east lower CAD cap is a broken C-shaped annulus. A complete octagonal body is reconstructed using measured lower-cap support lines at the eight orientations of the measured upper octagon, guided by built photographs. Individual rims remain separate. Four simplified metal crown ribs are thickened to0.30m diameter; they are not a surveyed ornamental mesh.

simplificationDecision.scope: This SMM construction only; not a claim about all Manifold simplification.
simplificationDecision.diagnosis: Before global simplify(.015), the carved union had no spurious sloping faces on the front side terrace. Afterwards6 upward triangles crossed from the31.826m lateral terrace to37m nave in local a8..13,b1.6..6. The global operation is omitted. Curves are reduced before booleans instead.
simplificationDecision.regenerationGuard: Eight independent fixed CAD terrace planes, including the two front points that detect the observed failure. Mesh preservation tolerance0.02m; this is not a physical survey accuracy claim.
